name: odoo-verifactu-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Spanish tax compliance in Odoo: Veri*Factu and SII status, AEAT errors, QR and CSV per invoice, and a VAT summary by tax.
long_description: Ask your AI assistant which invoices the AEAT rejected and why, which ones are still pending, when the certificate expires, or how much output and input VAT the quarter has. Works with Odoo's own Spanish modules (l10n_es_edi_verifactu, l10n_es_edi_sii) and with the OCA ones (l10n_es_verifactu_oca, l10n_es_aeat_sii_oca), on Odoo 16 to 20. It only reads: it never sends, cancels or changes anything.

tools.name: compliance_overview
tools.description: Installed Spanish modules, company setup, certificates and invoice counts by Veri*Factu and SII state.

tools.name: verifactu_invoices
tools.description: Customer invoices with their Veri*Factu state, AEAT CSV and last error.

tools.name: verifactu_errors
tools.description: AEAT errors of the period grouped by message, with sample invoices.

tools.name: sii_invoices
tools.description: Issued and received invoices with their SII state, CSV and last error.

tools.name: invoice_aeat_detail
tools.description: One invoice at the AEAT: state, QR, CSV, submission history and errors.

tools.name: vat_summary
tools.description: Output and input VAT by tax for the period, with bases. A working aid for form 303.

odoo_api_key.title: API key
odoo_api_key.description: Odoo → Preferences → Account Security → New API Key. Use a user with read access to Accounting.

odoo_db.title: Database
odoo_db.description: Only needed if the server hosts several databases, or for Odoo 16-18.

odoo_username.title: Login (Odoo 16-18 only)
odoo_username.description: Leave empty on Odoo 19 and later. On Odoo 16-18, the user's login email.
